positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Work with C#, javascript, html, angular, css, sql, and visual studio; responsible for maintaining in-house website and ssis packages; use JIRA to manage current projects/tasks; responsible for creating new features and improving the usability of existing application

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked with C#; MVC, Webforms, SQL, and Visual Studio; was responsible for maintaining amazon/customer facing website and in-house application; also responsible for technical IT related issues (internet down, software installation, etc). Initially worked under a manager, and later worked directly under the owner.

positions.title: Software Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Worked with Basic, VB.net, and ASP.net (as well as Unidata) on a proprietary application called Avante; I used a queue to keep track of which projects I needed to be working on; and each project went through testing, training, and then pushed to live when completed with no issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked with in-house applications, vbscript, and vb.net to create/maintain/support custom customer projects. I frequently used their scripting software, task scheduling software (not windows version), downtime reporting software, HL7 message modification software and many freeware tools to create custom setups for customers who are less technical. I built a few highly used programs too - one of them is currently used to update each employee with their assigned tasks or group related tasks requiring their attention

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Solely responsible for the UI which allowed customizing of the integration process between Labtech and other APIs. Some include Connectwise, Autotask, and Tigerpaw; these had APIs which were utilized by its respective program... So, a customer would buy Labtech (Network Admin Software) and Connectwise (PSA Tool); and then my UI program would be used to ensure the data matches up and the two different applications were able to easily communicate between each other based on customer needs.

This position consisted of research, development, testing, qa, and support of each UI.

positions.title: Junior Developer/QA Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with proprietary applications to develop data extraction modules, used for gathering job listings or employment opportunities and posting on the government sponsored, in-house developed web application; later was promoted to QA Automation, where I developed automated scripts to test the web application which lists the jobs (EmployFL/NHWorks/Pretty much all the OneStop Career Center Websites)

As QA Automation Engineer, I was responsible for maintaining multiple scripts which were versatile enough to test all 50+ websites (functionality was prioritized over validity); and used a language similar to vba/vbscript within a software called TestPartner, which was an user emulation software allowing us to automate QA testing for anything repetitive or methodical.
